## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth is weak (2/11) and both Financials and Industrials are negative, with only pockets of defensive strength (Utilities/JNJ) not broad enough to offset the downside.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%). Utilities showing mild support (SO noted in headlines) and Materials has isolated leaders DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) but is mixed overall.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Financials lag: WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%), JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -8.81%). Consumer Discretionary and Industrials are weak with BA BELOW TREND (1W: -9.18% | 1M: -11.16%) and GE BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -4.34%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%), LRCX RECOVERY (1W: +6.46% | 1M: -9.64%), APD RECOVERY (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%), INTC RECOVERY (1W: +5.41% | 1M: -5.22%). Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership given weak breadth.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: GE BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -4.34%), TMO BELOW TREND (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -11.83%), SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%), KHC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.99% | 1M: -8.13%) — weakness concentrated in Financials, Healthcare and Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: DOW (1W: +10.04%), OXY (1W: +7.32%), LRCX (1W: +6.46%), APD (1W: +5.80%), INTC (1W: +5.41%). Major divergence: multiple large-cap techs show 1W vs 1M disagreement (RECOVERY/CORRECTION patterns), so treat recent momentum as tactical, not confirmation of broader risk appetite.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed to weak with notable dispersion — AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -9.21%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.28% | 1M: -1.96%), NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -5.15%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%). Sector showing internal rotation and trend confusion after sharper 1W moves; monitor tech divergence for trend confirmation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are broadly weak with WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%), JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -8.81%) and V BELOW TREND (1W: -3.22% | 1M: -6.71%). Breadth and price action confirm defensive backdrop rather than cyclical leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare under pressure: TMO BELOW TREND (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -11.83%), SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.81%) remains a lone defensive outperformer; sector tone is defensive but narrow.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to Energy/defensive Utilities and diagnose Materials winners (DOW, XOM, CVX) while reducing exposure to weak Financials and high-beta Tech names showing broad 1M weakness. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; position sizing should reflect RISK-OFF backdrop and headline-driven dispersion.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%). BEARISH: ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -3.05%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%), META BELOW TREND (1W: -4.83% | 1M: -8.22%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.38% | 1M: +7.50%) — watch XOM/CVX/OXY for follow-through. BEARISH: Financials (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -9.44%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -3.17% | 1M: -6.59%) where downside remains concentrated.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%) for continuation above recent pivot; DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) for leadership confirmation; NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -5.15%) as a trigger for tech risk-on only if 1M trend stabilizes.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
APD (+60): Wells Fargo upgrade; APD RECOVERY (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%) — price action confirms the news-driven uptick. AMAT (+55): AI-capacity commentary; AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%) — sentiment confirms momentum. DOW (+55): Price target lift; DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) — clear confirmation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ADBE (-50): Analyst downgrade; ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -3.05%) — sentiment confirmed by price. SYK (-60): Cyberattack headline; SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%) — confirming weakness. INTU (-55): Weak guidance shock; INTU CORRECTION (1W: -8.56% | 1M: +10.08%) — bearish sentiment diverges from 1M strength, watch for trend break.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with style mixed / no clear leadership. XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%) and DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) are showing relative strength. Key risk is the major tech divergence and clustered negative headlines (ADBE, SYK, WFC) that could accelerate sector rotation or episodic selling.
